posts.title: Take the Philpapers survey
posts.description: Every so often I see a really bad "choose your philosopher" quiz. This hasn't been getting much better despite the (by all accounts very well-read) AIs now writing the quizzes. But if we're going to reduce philosophy to a series of binary forced choices, then we should really use the king of binary forced choice: the PhilPapers Survey ! posts.title: Timeline of emergent capabilities
posts.description: In 2018, no program could take arbitrary unstructured English input and give a related continuation of it. In 2019, one could.
